name: Topsports International Holdings Limited
summary: Topsports International Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, an investment holding company, engages in the trading of sportswear products in the People's Republic of China. The company is involved in leasing commercial spaces to other retailers for concessionaire sale; provision of information technology, media communication, and marketing services; operation of sports cities business. It sells its products through retail outlets, e-commerce platform, and wholesalers. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
